selected_script.angle: Utilizing the side of a metal kitchen cart to secure rolling spice jars and hang tools
selected_script.hook: Stop letting your spice jars tip over and slide around every time you move your kitchen cart.

script_record.pain_point: Spices tipping over and rolling on moving kitchen carts
script_record.conflict_hook: Stop letting your spice jars tip over and slide around every time you move your kitchen cart.
script_record.product_solution: Heavy-duty matte black magnetic spice racks snapping onto the cart side.

timeline.scene: A handheld shot of a kitchen cart being pushed, causing spice jars on the top tray to wobble and tip over messily.
A matte black carbon steel magnetic rack snaps securely onto the metal side of the cart, and spice jars are placed neatly inside.
Close-up showing the rack staying perfectly in place with spices inside while the cart rolls smoothly.
Close-up of detachable metal hooks hanging from the bottom edge of the rack holding kitchen scissors.
Two racks mounted vertically on the side of the cart, fully organized, freeing up the entire top shelf.
Text overlay: 'Clear your clutter today.' with a clean shot of the organized kitchen cart.
